[TOC]

### Prerequisites:
- The device network can access the Internet normally, for example: 4G dial-up is successful or wired network routing is successful or WiFi connection is successful, refer to the article introduction of "Function Usage" >>> "Network Function"!
- The device and computer are in the same LAN segment, and the computer can ping the local IP address of the device

### Operation steps:
1. Open the computer browser and enter the local network IP address of the device, fill in the login password "Adm_123" and click "Login". The local network IP address of the device can be viewed by referring to the article introduction of "Function Usage" >>> "Network Function"
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3e7dd3e6a73bfa81d053a4a6ff25dba8)

2. Click "General Settings" >>> "Basic Settings" >>> "Basic Information" >>> "Device Number" column, fill in the device number and save
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=b4d3a9f12efd80401783537fd5d4f751)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=d8695d7bb9c330f3c8e7515131d3b576)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=f7fa3e0243519ea8fce08e3adbf92a43)

3. Return to the previous menu and click "Network Settings" ">>>"Platform Settings" column Select IP or domain name registration, fill in the IP or domain name address, fill in the port number to save
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3b5f2eb876420e159f3c22f9b99b17ba)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=3a4a7028e6fd9e983bb6c61beed7133f)

4. Return to the previous menu and click "System Information" in the upper right corner ">>>"CMS Module" column Click to expand View the first item Status Is the connection successful That is, whether the private platform registration is successful
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=9aa5196d6f1ecb6b8eb39d776ea745ee)
![](http://pug2.4000329988.com/fqa/server/index.php?s=/api/attachment/visitFile&sign=c94fdc2b43d3d3bacc80021022ee3ae5)
